sources.finding: Table 1 separates electric utilities from IPP & CHP. API aliases claiming electric power sector are too broad.
Native browser definition hierarchy verifies all-fuel and fuel-component distinctions; source labels themselves can conflict.

EIA-860 census covers facilities at least 1 MW. Generator capacity by energy source is assigned to predominant fuel. Receipt price is distinct from all purchases; EIA-111 tracks international electricity trade.
Electricity consumption is retail sales to ultimate customers; SEDS reallocates legacy Other to commercial/transportation.
Net-metered capacity/customer accounts are a subset, not whole capacity/customer totals; surplus sales do not measure total generation.

definitionProbes.result: Series-ID compatibility wrapper still returns ambiguous biomass label for OB2 and OBW; no semantic resolution. Wrapper ignores supplied date bounds (23 annual rows returned); never use its bounds as coverage proof.

All six 2024 summary API values match corresponding published Table 1 fields. generation-elect-utils is electric utilities, not the entire electric-power sector; capacity-elec-utilities has the same label problem.
Sector 95 is labelled Coal Consumption but has generation from gas, solar and other fuels. It is not a product filter or a reliable named sector. Remains pending.

metadataConflicts.resolution: Electric utilities only, confirmed by published table and call 1422. Do not map as whole electric-power sector.
Other renewables excludes hydro; subset renewable.
Unresolved biomass component definitions; retain pending, never infer whole from duplicate biomass name.
Technical Notes p.22 explicitly defines sectors 2/3 as independent/non-regulated power producers; browser electric utility wording is wrong. Both remain subsets of electric power.

expectationsRecordedBeforeClassifierEdit: Retail sales supports electricity sales and owner-approved consumption basis; customer accounts are a permitted activity.
Net-metering customers and capacity remain subsets of total customers and capacity.
AOR must not qualify as whole renewable; PV and solar thermal must not qualify as whole solar; all-size TSN takes preference over utility SUN.
Coal ranks and refinery fuel components remain subsets.
Operational all-sector fuel consumption is only generating-facility use, not total product use; industrial/commercial facility fuel is not whole-sector use.
Source/disposition net interstate trade is not gross imports; total supply/disposition are balances, not consumption.
Summary ranks, emissions, prime source and losses are outside locked activities.
The owner approved utility-scale generation conditionally; do not extend that facility-size exception to capacity.
No product/sector/column Cartesian combination proves publication; verify actual observations and all required dimensions in B1.

biomassComponentCorroboration.inference: Same geography, frequency, units and EIA-923 source: OB2 corresponds numerically to Other Waste Biomass; OBW to Other Waste Biomass plus Biogenic Municipal Solid Waste. Both exclude the separately published wood and landfill-gas components of BIO. The exact code meanings are inferred from 10 years of source agreement, not explicitly given by the ambiguous API label. Keep pending until an explicit code-to-component definition is found; do not convert corroboration into proof.

standingScopeAmendment.effect: Supersedes earlier generation-only and survey-population-only exclusions. Labelled headline scope is conditionally accepted with broader-total preference. Product, sector, ownership and geography distinctions remain.
